Accumulate.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"\"" (field name passed empty, Accumulate.cpp:20). Per-evaluation sum, desired update interval 1 s, not scaled by elapsed time.

Default.notes: Option used when the current biome has no entry. Required unless >= 9 biome entries are given; then the CrystalCaves option is the default (null if CrystalCaves itself is the one missing). Error: "Default Must be set unless all biomes are specified"

extra.notes: Key = biome name or alias (see enums.BiomeKey); several aliases map to one biome, the last one read wins. Keys are looked up in a TMap<FString> (case-insensitive). Unknown key -> error "Unrecognized Biome '<key>'"

ByBiome.notes: Selects on the PLS Biome object's name (BIOME_*). 'Mutate' is skipped by the base ConfigureMutator.

Default.notes: Used outside a deep dive (MissionStructure 0) and for missing stages. Error if absent: "'Default' Value must be set"

Stage2.notes: Deep dive mission index 1 AND index 2

Stage3.notes: Parsed, but never selected: index 2 returns Stage2Mutator (bug at ByDDStage.cpp:37)

ByDDStage.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (ByDDStage.cpp:147). Keys matched case-insensitively (SwitchString/StriStri).

Default.notes: Error if absent: "'Default' must be set" (ByDNA.cpp:262)

extra.notes: Key = mission DNA "<type>,<length>,<complexity>": comma-separated, each part trimmed and lowercased; type in enums.DNAMissionType (or 'x' = any), length/complexity 1..3 or 'x'; missing trailing parts = 'x'; 4+ parts or a bad part -> error "Invalid Mission DNA: <key>". Lookup priority: type+len+comp, type+len, type+comp, len+comp, type, len, comp, then Default (ByDNA.cpp:300); a key 'x,x,x' is never looked up.

ByDNA.notes: Length/complexity come from GeneratedMission DNA NumberOfDots.

Default.notes: Used when the monitor state is invalid or has no option. Error if absent: "The Default value must be set."

extra.notes: Key = a EscortPhase name (enum display name, looked up case-insensitively). Unknown key -> error "Unrecognized Escort State <key>"

ByEscortPhase.notes: If the monitor cannot be obtained Validate returns invalid with no message -> base adds "Unspecified Mutator Error". StringToEnum built from the first 9 enumerators.

items.notes: An option: any mutator/literal of the type the enclosing value expects (OptionsBaseClass, set by the factory from the parent's base type)

Values.notes: Exactly 3 options, indexed by mission Complexity dots - 1 (min 0). Key compared case-SENSITIVELY (EqualEqual_StrStr). Errors: "Values must be a list", "Values must be a list with 3 elements", absent -> "The field Values must be set"

ByMissionComplexity.notes: Any other key -> error "Only the field Values is expected."

items.notes: An option: any mutator/literal of the type the enclosing value expects (OptionsBaseClass, set by the factory from the parent's base type)

Values.notes: Exactly 3 options, indexed by mission Duration dots - 1 (min 0). Key compared case-SENSITIVELY (EqualEqual_StrStr). Errors: "Values must be a list", "Values must be a list with 3 elements", absent -> "The field Values must be set"

ByMissionDuration.notes: Any other key -> error "Only the field Values is expected."

Default.notes: Required unless all 9 mission types are given (then the Mining option is the default). Error: "Either Provide a 'Default' or set all mission types"

extra.notes: Key = mission type name (TSet lookup, case-insensitive). Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\""

ByMissionType.notes: Current type from the FSD game mode class (GM_*_C -> name, enums.MissionType); unknown game mode -> Default.

Default.notes: Used when the monitor state is invalid or has no option. Error if absent: "The Default value must be set."

extra.notes: Key = a RefineryPhase name (enum display name, looked up case-insensitively). Unknown key -> error "Unrecognized Refinery State <key>"

ByRefineryPhase.notes: If the monitor cannot be obtained Validate returns invalid with no message -> base adds "Unspecified Mutator Error". StringToEnum built from the first 8 enumerators.

items.notes: An option: any mutator/literal of the type the enclosing value expects (OptionsBaseClass, set by the factory from the parent's base type)

Values.notes: Raw JSON array; option i is used after i resupplies were called (index clamped to the last). Error if not an array: "Field 'Values' must be an array". Not checked for presence (unclear what an empty list does: Select returns no option)

ByResuppliesCalled.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (ByResuppliesCalled.cpp:69). Selects only on the server.

Default.notes: Used when the monitor state is invalid or has no option. Error if absent: "The Default value must be set."

extra.notes: Key = a SaboPhase name (enum display name, looked up case-insensitively). Unknown key -> error "Unrecognized Sabo State <key>"

BySaboPhase.notes: If the monitor cannot be obtained Validate returns invalid with no message -> base adds "Unspecified Mutator Error". StringToEnum built from the first 11 enumerators.

Default.notes: Error if absent: "The Default value must be set." Used when not a salvage mission or the phase has no option.

extra.notes: Key = salvage phase (TSet ValidStates, case-insensitive). Unknown -> error "Unrecognized Salvage State <key>"

BySalvagePhase.notes: Phase computed from OBJ_1st_Salvage (BySalvagePhase.cpp:6): Mules while ActorsSalvaged < ActorsToSalvage (or ActorsToSalvage == 0); then Uplink / Refuel while that defense event's Progress < 1; else PointsRepaired 0 -> PreUplink, 1 -> PreRefuel, else Finished.

Default.notes: Error if absent: "A 'Default' must be provided"

Dump.notes: Value ignored; logs every Objective class name at Error level (PrintAllSecondaries)

extra.notes: Key = objective class name, with or without the _C suffix. Unknown -> error "Unrecognized Secondary \"<key>\""

BySecondary.notes: Picks the first configured objective (map order) present among the current secondary objectives, else Default.

ByTime.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). Value = InitialValue + RateOfChange * max(t - StartDelay, 0), t = mission time (0 until synced).

EDs.notes: Candidate descriptor names. Error if absent: "EDs must be set"

Lock.notes: While true, the last pick is reused (one draw per lock period)

ChooseNEnemies.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). If |EDs| <= N returns EDs unchanged; else a weighted draw without replacement, weight = 1/Rarity from the ED registry (unregistered EDs weight 0).

Enable.notes: Countdown runs while true; restarts when it turns true again

Default.notes: Value while disabled; defaults to Stop

Countdown.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). Missing Enable or Start -> error "Enable and Start options are required.". Enabled: trunc(max(Stop, Start - seconds since enabled)); disabled: trunc(Default).

DefenseProgress.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No options allowed for this Mutator". Progress of the first AEVENT_DropPodDefense_Base with Progress < 1, else 0.

Delta.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). Change of Value since the previous evaluation, smoothed.

Resource.notes: English name (enums.Resource keys) or the RES_* asset name; anything else counts 0. Error if absent: "\"Resource\" must be specified"

DepositedResource.notes: Any other key -> error "Only \"Resource\" value is allowed for this Mutator". Team depository amount.

ED.notes: Not mutatable. Error if not a string: "ED Must be a String". Absent -> "" -> false

DescriptorExists.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True if the name is registered in the ED registry.

Default.notes: Returned when no escape droppod / no players

IncludeDowned.notes: Count downed dwarves in the average

DistanceToDroppod.notes: Any other key -> error "Only \"Default\" and \"IncludeDowned\" supported by this mutator.". Average distance of the counted dwarves to the escape droppod (CD2_Player_Monitor.cpp:567).

DrillerCount.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Drillers (BP_DrillerCharacter_C). Before mission time 60 s counted from the player array's SelectedCharacter, after from spawned characters (CD2_Player_Monitor.cpp:443).

StoppingAfter.notes: Seconds since the state began (inclusive range)

DuringDefend.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True while wave script EWC_Salvage_Defend_C has run for StartingAt..StoppingAfter s.

DuringDread.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True while any enums.DreadDescriptor has an active count > 0 (DuringDread.cpp:84).

StoppingAfter.notes: Seconds since the state began (inclusive range)

DuringDrillevator.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True while EWC_DeepScan_Drillevator_C has run for StartingAt..StoppingAfter s.

StoppingAfter.notes: Seconds since the state began (inclusive range)

DuringEggAmbush.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True while EWC_EggHunt_Ambush_C has run for StartingAt..StoppingAfter s.

DuringEncounters.notes: No params: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True until FSDGameState OnMatchStarted fires (Mission monitor IsEncounters).

StoppingAfter.notes: Seconds since the state began (inclusive range)

DuringExtraction.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True while any of EWC_EndMission_C / EWC_Escort_EndMission_C / EWC_Salvage_End_C / EWC_EndMission_MotherLode_C has run for StartingAt..StoppingAfter s.

StoppingAfter.notes: Seconds since the state began (inclusive range)

DuringGenericSwarm.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True while EWC_Generic_C has run for StartingAt..StoppingAfter s.

StoppingAfter.notes: Seconds since the state began (inclusive range)

DuringMission.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True while mission time is within StartingAt..StoppingAfter s.

StoppingAfter.notes: Seconds since the state began (inclusive range)

DuringPECountdown.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True while EWC_EndMission_MotherLode_C has run for StartingAt..min(StoppingAfter,140) s.

DwarfCount.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Player count: spawned player characters once mission time >= 60 s and any exist, else the network player array size.

DwarvesAmmo.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Average per-player AmmoPct; 1.0 with no players.

DwarvesDown.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Number of dwarves currently down.

DwarvesDownTime.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Max DownTime (seconds) over players; 0 with no players.

DwarvesDowns.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Cumulative downs this mission (monitor Downs counter).

DwarvesHealth.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Average per-player HealthPct; 1.0 with no players.

DwarvesRevives.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Cumulative revives this mission (monitor Revives counter).

DwarvesShield.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Average per-player ShieldPct; 1.0 with no players.

ElapsedExtraction.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No options allowed for this Mutator". Max seconds elapsed in EWC_Salvage_End_C / EWC_EndMission_MotherLode_C / EWC_EndMission_C (escort's EWC_Escort_EndMission_C is NOT included, unlike DuringExtraction); 0 if none.

EnemiesKilled.notes: Unknown key -> error "Only \"ED\" or \"EDs\" value is allowed for this Mutator". ED and EDs together -> error "Only ED or EDs may be set.". Death count of ED / sum over EDs / all dead enemies if neither.

Seconds.notes: Window length. Error if absent: "Seconds must be set."

EnemiesRecentlySpawned.notes: Unknown key -> error "Only \"ED\" or \"EDs\" and \"Seconds\" values are allowed for this Mutator". ED and EDs together -> error "Only ED or EDs may be set.". Spawns within the last Seconds of ED / EDs / all if neither (monitor bins of 2 s).

ED.notes: Not mutatable. Error if not a string: "ED must be a string"

EDs.notes: Not mutatable. Error: "EDs must be an list of descriptors". ED and EDs may both be given (appended).

ValueDuringCooldown.notes: Option selected while any listed ED is on cooldown (spawned within CooldownTime)

EnemyCooldown.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unrecognized field \"<key>\"". On the host: no ED/EDs -> "Either ED or EDs must be set."; missing any of the three -> "CooldownTime, ValueDuringCooldown, DefaultValue must all be set" (checks skipped on clients).

EnemyCount.notes: Unknown key -> error "Only \"ED\" or \"EDs\" value is allowed for this Mutator". ED and EDs together -> error "Only ED or EDs may be set.". Active count of ED / sum over EDs / all active enemies if neither.

EnemyDistance.notes: Unknown key -> error "Only \"ED\" or \"EDs\" value is allowed for this Mutator" (misleading text). Exactly one of ED / EDs required: "Either ED or EDs must be set". Per enemy: distance to the nearest alive player (within 100000).

EnemyHealth.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unsupported Field". Exactly one of ED / EDs required: "Either ED or EDs must be set". Aggregates EnemyHealthComponent GetHealthPct.

EngineerCount.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Engineers (BP_EngineerCharacter_C); see DrillerCount for timing.

GunnerCount.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Gunners (BP_GunnerCharacter_C); see DrillerCount for timing.

Resource.notes: English name (enums.Resource keys) or the RES_* asset name; anything else counts 0. Error if absent: "\"Resource\" must be specified"

HeldResource.notes: Any other key -> error "Only \"Resource\" value is allowed for this Mutator". Sum held in all players' inventories.

IWsLeft.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Number of players with HasIW (iron will available).

Then.notes: Selected on the space rig. Error if absent: "Then Must Be Set"

Else.notes: Selected elsewhere. Error if absent: "Else Must Be Set"

MissionState.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". NAME COLLISION: two assets named MissionState. Mission/MissionState always returns 0 (stub, MissionState.cpp:42); DwarfState/MissionState returns the RemainingIWs count (same as IWsLeft, DwarfState/MissionState.cpp:43). The registry is a TMap keyed by asset name (CD2_Mod.cpp:324), so whichever the asset registry lists last wins - unclear which.

Default.notes: Returned when the escape droppod or the escort mule is absent

MuleDistanceToDroppod.notes: Any other key -> error "Only \"Default\" supported by this mutator.". Distance escape droppod <-> BP_Donkey. Two identical assets (Mission/ and DwarfState/) share this name.

ResuppliesCalled.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Resupply pods called this mission.

ResupplyUsesConsumed.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Resupply uses taken.

ResupplyUsesLeft.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Uses remaining on existing pods.

ScoutCount.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Scouts (BP_NavigatorCharacter_C); see DrillerCount for timing.

SecondaryFinished.notes: No params: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). True when every non-primary objective IsCompleted (true if there are none).

items.notes: An option: any mutator/literal of the type the enclosing value expects (OptionsBaseClass, set by the factory from the parent's base type)

Sequence.notes: Raw JSON array. Errors: not an array -> "Must Be An Array"; empty/absent -> "'Sequence' Must Be Set"

Previous.notes: Rising edge goes back one step (cancels an advance in the same evaluation)

Repeat.notes: Wrap at the ends; false = stick at the end

InitialOffset.notes: Start index (truncated, clamped); also used on Reset

Reset.notes: While true: position back to InitialOffset (or 0)

Shuffle.notes: Play a shuffled order, reshuffled on every wrap/reset

Sequence.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). Shuffle and ShuffleOnce both present -> error "'Shuffle' and 'ShuffleOnce' are mutually exclusive".

ShieldsLeft.notes: No params: Any key other than "Mutate" -> error "No fields supported for this mutator.". Sum of ChargeCapacity AmmoCount over all AShieldGeneratorItem (current team shield charges).

SquareWave.notes: High when sin(360 * t / Period) > 0 else Low, t = mission time. ConfigureMutator collects errors (unknown key -> "Unexpected field \"\"", wrong type -> "Expected Float Value/Mutator") but then returns Errors = {} (SquareWave.cpp:232): every error is silently dropped and the bad param stays 0.

Enable.notes: Time accumulates while true. Error if absent: "'Enable' condition must be set."

AutoReset.notes: Reset to 0 whenever Enable is false

StopWatch.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). Seconds accumulated while Enable is true.

RateOfChange.notes: Per second; defaults to 0 here (ByTime's default is 1)

TimeDelta.notes: Same formula as ByTime. Unknown key -> error "Unexpected Mutator Field"; 'Mutate' is compared case-SENSITIVELY here (TimeDelta.cpp:125). Stops at the first error.

Resource.notes: English name (enums.Resource keys) or the RES_* asset name; anything else counts 0. Error if absent: "\"Resource\" must be specified"

TotalResource.notes: Any other key -> error "Only \"Resource\" value is allowed for this Mutator". Held + deposited.

EscortPhase.notes: CD2_EEscort_State display names; produced by CD2_Escort_Monitor::GetEscortState (Escort_Monitor.cpp:33-95)

RefineryPhase.notes: CD2_ERefinery_State; enum 'Default' coincides with the mutator's Default key

SalvagePhase.notes: BySalvagePhase.ValidStates (plus key Default); computed in the mutator, no monitor

MissionState.notes: CD2_EMission_State; Mission monitor CheckState always returns Default and no mutator in this set reads it

BiomeKey.notes: ByBiome.KeyToBiomeName: config key -> biome asset name (10 biomes)

MissionType.notes: ByMissionType.ClassNameToKey: game-mode class -> key; keys = MissionTypeKeys

SecondaryObjective.notes: BySecondary.ValidObjectiveKeys; the _C suffix may be omitted in config

Resource.notes: CD2_Resource_Monitor.EnglishNames: English name -> RES_* asset name; either form is accepted (non-English names are used as-is)

EnemyAggregateType.notes: EnemyDistance/EnemyHealth Type: 'Min', 'Max'; any other string = average

WaveScript.notes: Wave-script classes each mission-phase mutator watches (CD2_Mission_Monitor active scripted waves)
